content: Google Play charges a one-time $25 registration fee (no recurring fee), payable by credit/debit card. New personal accounts (since early 2024) must verify access to a real Android device. Android App Bundle (.aab) format has been mandatory for new apps since August 2021, and enrollment in Play App Signing is mandatory for new apps to use AABs -- Google manages the app signing key while the developer holds an upload key.
